synopsis: DARPA named Duality Robotics and Intel-Federal as the two prime contractors for RACER-SIM in January 2022, a role also recorded in the glossary [f8419, f15831]. For RACER-SIM, Duality partnered with Neya Systems and was tasked with building an 80 km² off-road environment measuring 20 km by 4 km; the supplied facts describe the assignment, not its completion [f8421]. NASA JPL subsequently contracted Duality for RACER Phase II in September 2024, providing documented government use [f8422].

relations.note: Both identify Duality and Intel-Federal as RACER-SIM primes announced in January 2022.
